capabilities: browse web pages in a multi-tab embedded browser with pinned and temporary tabs
clip raw page content and selected text into notes with Quick Save
run AI analysis templates for briefings, concept notes, and concept maps
extract YouTube metadata from captured videos
configure AI providers, models, note templates, and pinned sites
extras: Desktop-only (uses desktop-only APIs). README includes a BRAT fallback install path for when the plugin is temporarily absent from the community directory during review. States that it collects no telemetry and that AI analysis uses only user-configured providers.
problem: Obsidian's built-in web viewing doesn't capture page content into notes, so saving web research means leaving the app or copying text manually.
summary: Multi-tab web browser inside Obsidian that clips pages and runs AI analysis templates on captured content.
